parts.stem: Put the following steps of a reflex action in the correct order from first to last.

items.value: The muscles contract and bring about the response to pull the hand away from the stimulus (hot stove).
The nerve impulses are transmitted to the arm muscles.
Nerve impulses are transmitted out of the spinal cord along a motor nerve fiber.
The nerve impulses are transmitted along a sensory nerve fiber into the spinal cord.
Sensory nerve endings in the skin produce nerve impulses in response to a stimulus (a hot stove).

correct_answer: Sensory nerve endings in the skin produce nerve impulses in response to a stimulus (a hot stove).
The nerve impulses are transmitted along a sensory nerve fiber into the spinal cord.
Nerve impulses are transmitted out of the spinal cord along a motor nerve fiber.
The nerve impulses are transmitted to the arm muscles.
The muscles contract and bring about the response to pull the hand away from the stimulus (hot stove).
